fields.summary_ko.0: Following Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return announcement, SanDisk (SNDK) stock jumped 20.5%, with Nvidia (NVDA) rising 35.5%, lifting AI stocks across the board.
fields.summary_ko.1: With Nvidia's customer investment strategy continuing to drive GPU sales growth, SanDisk's NAND memory chip sales are expected to increase; current stock is undervalued at under 5x net income against 40% annual growth expectations.
